moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio orbit, written here): A dot on an arm of radius 43 px circles a fixed centre: arm rotation 0 → 360° linear, constant radius, looping; site DOM demo 2600 ms per lap (motion_ms 1100); a faint circular guide and the centre dot stay still. Port as a wrapper rotating with the child offset by the radius. Params: duration: một vòng (1.1 s) · radius (43 px) · direction: chiều quay (thuận) · repeat.
